bifrost: springboard/ui/src/geo.rs (CoordinateRegion, CoordinateSpan, MapPoint, MapSize, MapRect, format_distance); springboard/src/shell/weather/data.rs (Open-Meteo place search and forecasts only); springboard/src/shell/photos/exif.rs (GPS formatting only); springboard/sdk/src/workspace.rs (open a URL, no maps handling)
summary: MapKit covers embedded map views, annotations and overlays, search, geocoding, directions, Look Around and snapshots. BifrOSt now has a pure-Rust model of its map-coordinate types (regions, spans, Web Mercator map points, map sizes, map rectangles, great-circle distance and distance strings) in bifrost-ui. It still has no map view, tiles, annotations, overlays, directions, snapshots or SDK map API. The Weather app's place search uses Open-Meteo rather than Apple services.
